blocks.zh: 第六章 B 部分：cGMP 廠房佈局策略 — 流向、清潔與特殊區域
blocks.en: Chapter 6, Part B: cGMP Facility Layout Strategy - Flows, Cleaning and Special Areas

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解物流隔離（Logistical Segregation）的定義與目的：批次隔離、產品隔離、病毒削減操作隔離，以及開放式與封閉式製程的區別。
blocks.en: Understand the definition and purpose of logistical segregation: batch, product and virus-reduced operations segregation, and the difference between open and closed processing.

blocks.zh: 掌握廠房與製程流向（Facility & Process Flows）的三個層次：邏輯製程展示、避免混淆、保護房間環境；並比較雙走廊與單走廊廠房設計的適用情境。
blocks.en: Master the three levels of facility and process flows: logical process presentation, avoiding mix-ups, and protecting the room environment; and compare when to use a dual-corridor versus a single-corridor facility design.

blocks.zh: 了解設備與廠房清潔（Equipment & Facility Cleaning）的設計原則：CIP/SIP 整合、設備清洗室佈局（二房 vs. 三房）、不同等級環境的表面完工要求。
blocks.en: Understand the design principles for equipment and facility cleaning: CIP/SIP integration, equipment wash area layout (two-room vs. three-room), and surface finish requirements for different classes of environment.

blocks.zh: 區分疫苗及生物危害圍堵（Vaccines & Biological Hazard Containment）與標準 GMP 設施的衝突：BSL 負壓要求 vs. GMP 正壓要求，以及如何在設計中解決此矛盾。
blocks.en: Distinguish where vaccine and biological hazard containment conflicts with a standard GMP facility: BSL negative pressure vs. GMP positive pressure, and how to resolve this conflict in the design.

blocks.zh: 識別生產支援區域（Production Support Areas）的關鍵功能，以及新興國家廠房設計中模組化設計的優勢。
blocks.en: Identify the key functions of production support areas, and the advantages of modular design for facilities in emerging countries.

blocks.zh: 6.4 Logistical Segregation Considerations 物流隔離考量
blocks.en: 6.4 Logistical Segregation Considerations (Logistical Segregation)

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Logistical Segregation（物流隔離）：指透過空間或物理手段將系統或操作分離，核心目的只有一個——防止混淆（prevent mix-ups）。與GMP分類環境的保護不同，物流隔離關注的是「正確的東西在正確的地方」。
blocks.en: Logistical Segregation: separating systems or operations by spatial or physical means. It has one core purpose: to prevent mix-ups. Unlike the protection provided by a GMP-classified environment, logistical segregation is about "the right thing in the right place".

blocks.zh: Mix-up（混淆） 是一種特別危險的錯誤——你完全不知道它發生了。批次標籤搞錯、管線接錯、已病毒削減的中間產品與未削減的放在一起，都可能導致產品召回或病人傷害。
blocks.en: A mix-up is an especially dangerous error because you have no idea it has happened. A wrong batch label, a mis-connected line, or virus-reduced intermediate stored alongside unreduced material can all lead to a product recall or patient harm.

blocks.zh: 防止混淆的工具層次：
blocks.en: Hierarchy of tools for preventing mix-ups:

blocks.zh: 實體隔離（最強）：獨立房間、氣鎖
blocks.en: Physical segregation (strongest): separate rooms, airlocks

blocks.zh: RFID / 條碼掃描（中等）：電子追蹤
blocks.en: RFID / barcode scanning (moderate): electronic tracking

blocks.zh: 顏色編碼（輔助）：管線、連接器
blocks.en: Color coding (supporting): lines, connectors

blocks.zh: 行政管控（最弱）：SOP、培訓
blocks.en: Administrative controls (weakest): SOPs, training

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像機場的單向旅客動線設計。出境旅客、入境旅客、轉機旅客走不同的路線，不僅是為了安全審查，更是為了防止「人員混淆」——讓正確的人到達正確的地方。生物製藥廠房的物流隔離設計就像機場動線規劃師，確保每種物料、人員、廢棄物都在對應的「通道」中移動，不能走錯路。
blocks.en: Think of the one-way passenger flow at an airport. Departing, arriving and transit passengers take different routes, not only for security screening but also to prevent "people mix-ups", so that the right people end up in the right place. Logistical segregation in a biopharmaceutical facility works like an airport flow planner, making sure every material, person and waste stream moves in its own "lane" and cannot take the wrong route.

blocks.zh: Ballroom 就像是機場的開放式大候機廳：空間共用、但透過電子票務（RFID/條碼）確保每位旅客登上正確航班。
blocks.en: A ballroom is like the open main terminal hall of an airport: the space is shared, but electronic ticketing (RFID/barcode) makes sure every passenger boards the correct flight.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 病毒削減操作（Virus Reduced Operations）的隔離是監管機構的明確要求！一旦批次經過病毒去除/滅活步驟，就必須與未處理的上游物料實體隔離，因為任何交叉污染都會讓下游的無病毒保證失效。
blocks.en: Segregation of virus-reduced operations is an explicit regulatory expectation! Once a batch has passed a virus removal/inactivation step, it must be physically separated from untreated upstream material, because any cross-contamination would invalidate the downstream virus-free assurance.

blocks.zh: 封閉製程（Closed Processing）可以打破傳統的隔離需求——當系統完全密封，批次和產品可以共存於同一空間，這是 Ballroom 概念的基礎。但一旦涉及開放操作，所有隔離要求就重新生效。
blocks.en: Closed processing can remove the traditional need for segregation: when a system is fully sealed, batches and products can coexist in the same space, which is the basis of the ballroom concept. But as soon as an open operation is involved, all segregation requirements apply again.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 在一個 Ballroom 設計的生物製藥廠中，同時生產兩個不同產品的兩條批次。哪些情境下可以接受？哪些情境下絕對不行？
blocks.en: In a ballroom-style biopharmaceutical facility, two batches of two different products are manufactured at the same time. In which situations is this acceptable? In which is it absolutely not?

blocks.zh: 使用 RFID 技術追蹤批次時，如果 RFID 讀取器故障，備用的物流隔離措施應該是什麼？
blocks.en: When RFID is used to track batches, what backup logistical segregation measures should apply if the RFID reader fails?

blocks.zh: 6.4.1–6.4.5 Segregation Sub-types 各類隔離細節
blocks.en: 6.4.1-6.4.5 Segregation Sub-types (Details of Each Segregation Type)

blocks.zh: 四種隔離類型總結：
blocks.en: Summary of the four segregation types:

blocks.zh: 批次隔離（Batch Segregation）：防止同產品不同批次的混淆，重點在共用元件（CIP 管線、傳遞頭）的控制
blocks.en: Batch segregation: prevents mix-ups between different batches of the same product; the focus is control of shared components (CIP lines, transfer heads)

blocks.zh: 產品隔離（Product Segregation）：不同產品共存於同一空間時，共用 CIP 系統是最大風險——一個產品的清洗殘留可能影響另一個
blocks.en: Product segregation: when different products share the same space, a shared CIP system is the biggest risk, because cleaning residue from one product could affect another

blocks.zh: 病毒削減隔離（Virus Reduced Segregation）：法規明確要求，必須獨立通道進入，與上游分離——一次性系統是最佳解決方案
blocks.en: Virus-reduced segregation: an explicit regulatory expectation; entry must be through a separate route, separated from upstream; single-use systems are the best solution

blocks.zh: 含細胞 vs. 無細胞：下游純化後的無細胞區域必須防止上游含活細胞物料的污染；這影響 HVAC 分區、人員動線及服裝策略
blocks.en: Cell-containing vs. cell-free: downstream purified cell-free areas must be protected from contamination by upstream material containing live cells; this affects HVAC zoning, personnel flow and gowning strategy

blocks.zh: 共用 CIP 系統是高風險點！兩個「封閉」系統共用 CIP 管線時，如果一側系統的完整性受損（如洩漏），就可能透過共用管路將污染傳遞到另一側。這就是為什麼病毒削減區域通常採用一次性系統——完全消除共用清洗系統的風險。
blocks.en: A shared CIP system is a high-risk point! When two "closed" systems share a CIP line, a loss of integrity on one side (such as a leak) could carry contamination to the other side through the shared piping. This is why virus-reduced areas usually use single-use systems, which completely eliminate the risk of a shared cleaning system.

blocks.zh: 開放製程 vs. 封閉製程的隔離邏輯：封閉製程依靠系統完整性保護產品；開放製程則需要依靠環境（分類潔淨室）和人員管控來保護。這兩者混合時，開放操作必須有獨立的受控環境。
blocks.en: Segregation logic for open vs. closed processing: closed processing relies on system integrity to protect the product; open processing relies on the environment (classified cleanroom) and personnel controls. When the two are mixed, open operations must have their own controlled environment.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: CDMO 在承接生物製藥客戶時，最常遇到的問題是：「我的病毒滅活後的產品可以和滅活前的產品在同一個廠房運作嗎？」答案是：可以，但必須通過嚴格的風險評估，且兩者必須透過獨立氣鎖訪問的獨立套房分隔。如果客戶的上游製程使用不鏽鋼 CIP，而下游病毒削減製程使用一次性系統，通常可以在同一建築中共存，但需要明確的流向規範和人員/物料傳遞 SOP。
blocks.en: The question a CDMO hears most often from biopharmaceutical clients is: "Can my post-virus-inactivation product operate in the same facility as the pre-inactivation product?" The answer is yes, but only after a rigorous risk assessment, and the two must be separated into independent suites, each accessed through its own airlock. If the client's upstream process uses stainless steel CIP while the downstream virus-reduced process uses single-use systems, the two can usually coexist in the same building, but clear flow rules and SOPs for personnel/material transfer are needed.

blocks.zh: 一家 CDMO 計劃在同一廠房中為兩個客戶同時生產單株抗體（mAb）。一個產品使用不鏽鋼 CIP 系統，另一個使用一次性（Single-Use）系統。這種配置的主要風險是什麼？如何控制？
blocks.en: A CDMO plans to manufacture monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) for two clients at the same time in one facility. One product uses a stainless steel CIP system and the other uses a single-use system. What is the main risk of this arrangement, and how would you control it?

blocks.zh: 在風險評估「virus-reduced suite」的隔離方案時，你應該評估哪五個可能的污染途徑？
blocks.en: When risk-assessing the segregation scheme for a "virus-reduced suite", which five potential contamination routes should you evaluate?

blocks.zh: 6.5 Facility and Process Flows 廠房與製程流向
blocks.en: 6.5 Facility and Process Flows (Facility and Process Flows)

blocks.zh: 流向設計的三層目的（由低到高重要性）：
blocks.en: The three purposes of flow design (in increasing order of importance):

blocks.zh: Level 1 — 邏輯製程展示：廠房佈局必須讓查核人員（FDA 查廠官、客戶稽核）一眼看出製程的邏輯順序（上游 → 下游）。這是精實製造（Lean Manufacturing）的基本要求。
blocks.en: Level 1 - Logical process presentation: the facility layout must let an inspector (FDA investigator, client auditor) see the logical sequence of the process (upstream → downstream) at a glance. This is a basic requirement of lean manufacturing.

blocks.zh: Level 2 — 避免混淆：cGMP 法規的明確要求，方法必須可展示（demonstrable）。光有 SOP 不夠，必須有實體或電子機制支撐。
blocks.en: Level 2 - Avoiding mix-ups: an explicit cGMP requirement, and the method must be demonstrable. SOPs alone are not enough; they must be backed by a physical or electronic mechanism.

blocks.zh: Level 3 — 環境保護：只有開放製程才需要。透過氣壓差（正壓梯度）、人員流向、設備流向設計，降低環境對暴露產品的污染風險。封閉製程因為系統密封，不需要環境保護流向。
blocks.en: Level 3 - Environmental protection: needed only for open processing. Pressure differentials (positive pressure cascade), personnel flow and equipment flow are designed to reduce the risk of the environment contaminating exposed product. Because closed systems are sealed, closed processing does not need environment-protecting flows.

blocks.zh: Level 1 就像廚房的動線設計——食材進來、備料、烹飪、裝盤、出菜，必須有邏輯順序，不能讓「出菜」和「垃圾清運」走同一條路。Level 2 是避免點錯菜——每道菜必須有標籤跟著走。Level 3 是高級餐廳的廚房管理——暴露的食物附近必須保持衛生環境，不能有污染源靠近。如果食物裝在密封容器裡（封閉製程），Level 3 就不需要，因為容器本身保護了食物。
blocks.en: Level 1 is like the flow design of a kitchen: ingredients come in, then prep, cooking, plating and serving, in a logical order, and "serving" and "garbage removal" must not share the same route. Level 2 is avoiding wrong orders: every dish must have a label traveling with it. Level 3 is the kitchen management of a high-end restaurant: exposed food must be kept in a hygienic environment, with no source of contamination nearby. If the food is in a sealed container (closed processing), Level 3 is not needed, because the container itself protects the food.

blocks.zh: 封閉製程革命性影響：Level 3 流向的消除是採用封閉製程（一次性系統、CIP/SIP）的重大優勢之一。傳統上，雙走廊設計（clean supply + dirty return）是 Level 3 需求驅動的。封閉製程讓單走廊設計成為可能，大幅降低廠房複雜度和建設成本。
blocks.en: The transformative impact of closed processing: eliminating Level 3 flows is one of the major advantages of adopting closed processing (single-use systems, CIP/SIP). Traditionally, the dual-corridor design (clean supply + dirty return) was driven by the Level 3 requirement. Closed processing makes a single-corridor design possible, greatly reducing facility complexity and construction cost.

blocks.zh: 從 FDA 查廠角度，Level 2（避免混淆）是必查項目——你必須能展示具體的防混淆機制，不能只說「我們有良好的 SOP」。
blocks.en: From the point of view of an FDA inspection, Level 2 (avoiding mix-ups) is a must-check item: you have to demonstrate a specific mix-up prevention mechanism, and cannot simply say "we have good SOPs".

blocks.zh: 一個完全封閉（fully closed）的生物製藥廠必須還要設計 Level 3 流向嗎？為什麼？
blocks.en: Does a fully closed biopharmaceutical facility still have to be designed with Level 3 flows? Why?

blocks.zh: 對於一個使用開放色譜柱填充（open chromatography packing）操作的設施，應該增加哪些流向控制措施？
blocks.en: For a facility with open chromatography packing operations, which additional flow control measures should be added?

blocks.zh: 6.5.4 Multiple vs. Single Production Corridor 雙走廊 vs. 單走廊設計
blocks.en: 6.5.4 Multiple vs. Single Production Corridor (Dual-Corridor vs. Single-Corridor Design)

blocks.zh: 雙走廊設計（Multiple Production Corridors）核心邏輯：
blocks.en: Core logic of the multiple production corridor design:

blocks.zh: 供應走廊（Clean Supply Corridor）：乾淨人員 + 原料 + 潔淨設備進入生產室
blocks.en: Clean supply corridor: clean personnel + raw materials + clean equipment enter the production rooms

blocks.zh: 返回走廊（Dirty Return Corridor）：使用後人員 + 髒設備 + 廢棄物離開生產室
blocks.en: Dirty return corridor: used personnel + dirty equipment + waste leave the production rooms

blocks.zh: 人員動線是環狀的：髒走廊 → 去服裝區 → 重新著裝 → 潔淨走廊
blocks.en: Personnel flow is a loop: dirty corridor → de-gowning → re-gowning → clean corridor

blocks.zh: 單走廊設計（Single Production Corridor）觸發條件：
blocks.en: Conditions that trigger a single production corridor design:

blocks.zh: CIP/SIP 整合（不鏽鋼設備就地清洗，不需運到設備洗滌室）
blocks.en: CIP/SIP integration (stainless steel equipment cleaned in place, with no need to move it to an equipment wash room)

blocks.zh: 大量使用一次性系統（Single-Use）：使用後直接丟棄，不需清洗
blocks.en: Heavy use of single-use systems: discarded after use, with no cleaning needed

blocks.zh: 可攜設備清洗需求降低 90%+，Level 3 流向消除
blocks.en: The need to wash portable equipment falls by 90%+, and Level 3 flows are eliminated

blocks.zh: 雙走廊廠房就像五星級飯店的後勤動線——有專門供服務員進入客房的「服務通道」，也有清出髒盤子和垃圾的「後勤通道」，兩條路永遠不交叉，確保客人永遠看不到髒東西，也確保衛生標準。
blocks.en: A dual-corridor facility is like the back-of-house flow of a five-star hotel: there is a "service route" for staff to enter guest rooms and a separate "back-of-house route" for removing dirty dishes and garbage. The two never cross, so guests never see anything dirty and hygiene standards are maintained.

blocks.zh: 單走廊廠房則像現代速食餐廳——因為大量使用拋棄式餐具（一次性系統），廚師不需要走去洗碗區，一切在工作站完成（CIP/SIP），一條走廊就夠了，而且還更有效率。
blocks.en: A single-corridor facility is like a modern fast-food restaurant: because it uses disposable tableware (single-use systems), the cook does not need to walk to a dishwashing area and everything is done at the workstation (CIP/SIP). One corridor is enough, and it is more efficient too.

blocks.zh: 設計決策矩陣 Design Decision Matrix
blocks.en: Design Decision Matrix

blocks.zh:
廠房走廊設計選擇指南：

條件                            建議設計
─────────────────────────────────────────
開放製程（暴露產品）            雙走廊（必須）
Level 3 流向需求高              雙走廊

CIP/SIP + 一次性系統為主        單走廊（可接受）
全封閉製程                      單走廊（推薦）
可攜設備清洗需求 <10%          單走廊（推薦）

可攜設備清洗需求降低量 > 90%
= 使用 CIP/SIP + Disposables 的典型結果
blocks.en:
Corridor design selection guide:

Condition                            Recommended design
-----------------------------------------------------------
Open processing (exposed product)    Dual corridor (required)
High Level 3 flow requirement        Dual corridor

Mainly CIP/SIP + single-use systems  Single corridor (acceptable)
Fully closed processing              Single corridor (recommended)
Portable equipment washing <10%     Single corridor (recommended)

Reduction in portable equipment washing > 90%
= typical result of using CIP/SIP + disposables

blocks.zh: 單走廊的隱性風險：當產品桶（bulk product container）和廢棄物共用同一條走廊時，必須確保產品桶是密封的（closed vessel）。密封的廢棄物容器的污染風險，遠小於非密封的走廊環境對開放產品桶的風險。最終批量產品桶在轉移到充填設施前，外表面必須清洗——這一點常被忽略！
blocks.en: The hidden risk of a single corridor: when the bulk product container and waste share the same corridor, you must make sure the product container is sealed (a closed vessel). The contamination risk from a sealed waste container is much smaller than the risk that an unsealed corridor environment poses to an open product container. The outer surface of the final bulk product container must be cleaned before it is transferred to the filling facility, a point that is often overlooked!

blocks.zh: CDMO 在評估新廠房設計時，最重要的決策之一是走廊策略。若客戶管線以小分子 API（開放製程）為主，雙走廊幾乎是必需的。若未來管線以抗體藥物（mAb，使用一次性生物反應器）為主，單走廊設計可節省大量建造成本（少一條走廊 = 少 20-30% 的廠房面積）並簡化驗證工作。在初期廠房規劃階段，就應確定走廊策略——這個決策一旦建好就很難改變。
blocks.en: One of the most important decisions for a CDMO evaluating a new facility design is the corridor strategy. If the client pipeline is mainly small-molecule APIs (open processing), a dual corridor is almost a necessity. If the future pipeline is mainly antibody drugs (mAbs, using single-use bioreactors), a single-corridor design can save a great deal of construction cost (one fewer corridor = 20-30% less floor area) and simplify validation work. The corridor strategy should be set at the early facility planning stage, because once it is built it is very hard to change.

blocks.zh: 一個全新的生物製藥 CDMO 廠房，計劃承接 mAb 和重組蛋白生產，大量使用一次性生物反應器。設計團隊建議採用單走廊。請列舉三個支持此決策的技術論據，以及一個需要謹慎評估的風險。
blocks.en: A brand-new biopharmaceutical CDMO facility plans to take on mAb and recombinant protein manufacturing, with heavy use of single-use bioreactors. The design team recommends a single corridor. List three technical arguments in support of this decision, and one risk that needs careful evaluation.

blocks.zh: 在單走廊設計中，最終批量產品桶（final bulk product container）在進入充填設施之前，應該執行哪些控制措施？
blocks.en: In a single-corridor design, what controls should be applied to the final bulk product container before it enters the filling facility?

blocks.zh: 6.6 Equipment and Facility Cleaning and Finishes 設備與廠房清潔及表面完工
blocks.en: 6.6 Equipment and Facility Cleaning and Finishes (Equipment and Facility Cleaning and Surface Finishes)

blocks.zh: 想像醫院的消毒中心（CSSD）：器械從手術室來（髒側），進入清洗機（穿透式設備），從另一側出來進入滅菌區（乾淨側），最後進入無菌器材儲存室。整個流程就是單向的，完全不走回頭路。生物製藥廠的設備清洗室與此設計邏輯完全相同。
blocks.en: Think of a hospital sterile services department (CSSD): instruments come from the operating theater (dirty side), pass through a washer (pass-through equipment), exit on the other side into the sterilization area (clean side), and finally go to the sterile supplies store. The whole flow is one-way, with no backtracking. The equipment wash area of a biopharmaceutical facility follows exactly the same design logic.

blocks.zh: Grade 7 的表面完工要求（齊平細節、包覆轉角）就像醫院手術室的牆壁——沒有死角、縫隙讓細菌藏匿，所有表面都可以用強力消毒劑擦拭而不損傷。
blocks.en: The surface finish requirements for Grade 7 (flush details, coved corners) are like the walls of a hospital operating theater: no dead corners or crevices where bacteria can hide, and all surfaces can be wiped with strong disinfectants without being damaged.

blocks.zh: 「家務性溢漏 vs. cGMP 問題」的關鍵判斷：這是一個非常重要的概念！在封閉製程 Ballroom 中，即使有設備破裂造成大量溢漏，只要鄰近設備也是密封的，溢漏物無法污染其他產品，這只是一個「清潔問題（housekeeping spill）」——可以繼續生產。但在開放製程中，任何溢漏都是嚴重的 cGMP 事件，可能污染整個房間，必須停產調查。
blocks.en: The key judgment of "housekeeping spill vs. cGMP issue": this is a very important concept! In a closed-processing ballroom, even if equipment fails and causes a large spill, as long as the neighboring equipment is also sealed, the spilled material cannot contaminate other products. It is only a "housekeeping spill" and production can continue. In open processing, however, any spill is a serious cGMP event that can contaminate the whole room, and production must stop for investigation.

blocks.zh: 「選擇性升級（Discretionary Upgrade）」的商業思考：將整廠統一使用 Grade 8 完工標準（包含 CNC 區域）增加了資本支出，但可以簡化清潔驗證工作，並有助於維持員工的「生產心態」。這是一個商業決策，不是法規要求。
blocks.en: The business thinking behind a "Discretionary Upgrade": using the Grade 8 finish standard throughout the whole facility (including CNC areas) increases capital expenditure, but it can simplify cleaning validation work and help maintain a "production mindset" among staff. This is a business decision, not a regulatory requirement.

blocks.zh: CDMO 廠房設計決策中，「設備清洗室要幾個房間」往往取決於未來客戶管線的規模。如果以小批量（Phase I/II）臨床試驗為主，兩房設計就夠了。如果以大規模商業生產為主，三房設計能大幅提高清洗吞吐量，減少設備等待清洗導致的生產瓶頸。設計時應考慮 10 年後的最大設計產能，而非當前產能。
blocks.en: In CDMO facility design decisions, "how many rooms the equipment wash area needs" often depends on the scale of the future client pipeline. If the work is mainly small-batch (Phase I/II) clinical trial material, a two-room design is enough. If it is mainly large-scale commercial production, a three-room design greatly increases wash throughput and reduces production bottlenecks caused by equipment waiting to be cleaned. Design for the maximum design capacity 10 years from now, not for current capacity.

blocks.zh: 一個 Grade 7 潔淨室和一個 CNC 房間在表面完工要求上有什麼關鍵差異？這些差異背後的科學原理是什麼？
blocks.en: What are the key differences in surface finish requirements between a Grade 7 cleanroom and a CNC room? What is the scientific rationale behind these differences?

blocks.zh: 某廠房中，一個密封的 2000L 不鏽鋼生物反應器發生管路接頭斷裂，1000L 培養基溢出到 Ballroom 地板。這是「家務性溢漏」還是「cGMP 問題」？如何判斷？
blocks.en: In a facility, a pipe connection on a sealed 2000 L stainless steel bioreactor breaks and 1000 L of culture medium spills onto the ballroom floor. Is this a "housekeeping spill" or a "cGMP issue"? How do you decide?

blocks.zh: 設備清洗室設計（Equipment Wash Area Design）：
blocks.en: Equipment Wash Area Design:

blocks.zh: 設計原則是「髒進、乾淨出」的單向流——穿透式清洗設備（pass-through washer / autoclave）是物理屏障，確保清洗前的「髒側（dirty side）」與清洗後的「乾淨側（clean side）」永遠不交叉。
blocks.en: The design principle is a one-way "dirty in, clean out" flow. Pass-through washing equipment (pass-through washer / autoclave) is a physical barrier that ensures the "dirty side" before washing and the "clean side" after washing never cross.

blocks.zh: 三房設計（Three Room）：高通量設施。髒拆裝室 → 組裝室 → 潔淨暫存室，高度專業化分工
blocks.en: Three-room design: for high-throughput facilities. Dirty disassembly room → assembly room → clean staging room, with highly specialized division of work

blocks.zh: 二房設計（Two Room）：低通量設施，合併組裝與暫存，使用單側滅菌鍋（single-sided autoclave）
blocks.en: Two-room design: for low-throughput facilities; assembly and staging are combined, and a single-sided autoclave is used

blocks.zh: 6.7 Clinical Trial and Commercial Production 臨床試驗與商業生產
blocks.en: 6.7 Clinical Trial and Commercial Production (Clinical Trial and Commercial Production)

blocks.zh: cGMP 合規要求的階段性（Phase-Appropriate GMP）：
blocks.en: Phase-appropriate GMP compliance requirements:

blocks.zh: Phase I（臨床一期）：豁免許多 cGMP 要求。主要目標是安全性，設施可以是研究型、彈性化設計。不需要完整的 cGMP 文件系統，但必須確保基本安全。
blocks.en: Phase I (clinical): exempt from many cGMP requirements. The main goal is safety, and the facility can be research-type and flexible in design. A full cGMP documentation system is not required, but basic safety must be ensured.

blocks.zh: Phase II 及以上：必須完全符合 cGMP 要求。廠房必須通過 GMP 驗證，文件系統必須完整。
blocks.en: Phase II and above: must fully comply with cGMP. The facility must pass GMP qualification and the documentation system must be complete.

blocks.zh: Phase II 與商業生產的關係：兩者 cGMP 合規要求完全相同！差異只在於規模（Scale），不在法規要求。
blocks.en: The relationship between Phase II and commercial production: the cGMP compliance requirements are exactly the same! The difference is only in scale, not in regulatory requirements.

blocks.zh: 「規模對齊（Scale Alignment）」的實際含義：在商業生產廠房生產 Phase II 藥物，主要挑戰是製程規模可能過小（低批量 = 低利用率 = 高成本），而非法規合規問題。
blocks.en: What "Scale Alignment" actually means: the main challenge of making a Phase II drug in a commercial production facility is that the process scale may be too small (small batches = low utilization = high cost), not regulatory compliance.

blocks.zh: Phase I 設施就像試驗廚房（Test Kitchen）——廚師可以自由探索食譜，不需要嚴格的標準化程序和品質管理系統。Phase II/III 以後就像工業廚房（Commercial Kitchen）——必須有 HACCP、SOP、定期稽核、嚴格清洗流程。兩者的標準食品安全要求相同，只是生產量不同。在工業廚房裡做一小份實驗菜，是規模問題，不是法規問題。
blocks.en: A Phase I facility is like a test kitchen: chefs can explore recipes freely, without strict standardized procedures and a quality management system. From Phase II/III onward it is like a commercial kitchen: HACCP, SOPs, regular audits and strict cleaning procedures are required. The food safety requirements are the same for both; only the production volume differs. Making a small batch of an experimental dish in a commercial kitchen is a scale issue, not a regulatory issue.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 的重要意義：CDMO 廠房若以 Phase II/III 和商業生產為主要業務，廠房設計必須從一開始就符合完整 cGMP 要求。不能「先建一個 Phase I 廠，再升級到 Phase II 廠」——後期升級改建的成本和驗證工作通常遠高於直接建造符合要求的廠房。
blocks.en: Significance for CDMOs: if a CDMO facility is mainly for Phase II/III and commercial production, the facility design must meet full cGMP requirements from the start. You cannot "first build a Phase I facility and then upgrade it to a Phase II facility", because the cost and validation work of a later upgrade and rebuild is usually far greater than building a compliant facility directly.

blocks.zh: Phase I 豁免某些 cGMP 要求，但這不代表沒有品質要求——只是靈活度更高，允許更多研究型判斷。FDA 查廠時對 Phase I 設施的標準確實較寬鬆，但一旦藥物進入 Phase II 就必須升級。
blocks.en: Phase I exempts certain cGMP requirements, but this does not mean there are no quality requirements; there is just more flexibility, allowing more research-type judgment. The FDA standard when inspecting a Phase I facility is indeed more relaxed, but once the drug enters Phase II the facility must be upgraded.

blocks.zh: 一家 CDMO 的客戶將一個 Phase I 臨床試驗用藥物轉為 Phase II。CDMO 必須在廠房和文件系統上做哪些改變？
blocks.en: A CDMO client moves a Phase I clinical trial drug into Phase II. What changes must the CDMO make to the facility and the documentation system?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 ISPE 指南說「在商業生產廠房做 Phase II 生產是規模對齊問題，而非法規隔離問題」？這對廠房設計有什麼實際意義？
blocks.en: Why does the ISPE Guide say that "performing Phase II production in a commercial production facility is a scale alignment issue, not a regulatory segregation issue"? What is the practical significance for facility design?

blocks.zh: 6.8 Vaccines and Biological Hazard Containment 疫苗與生物危害圍堵
blocks.en: 6.8 Vaccines and Biological Hazard Containment (Vaccines and Biological Hazard Containment)

blocks.zh: 關鍵衝突警示 Critical Design Conflict
blocks.en: Critical Design Conflict

blocks.zh: BSL 負壓 vs. GMP 正壓——廠房設計的根本矛盾！
blocks.en: BSL negative pressure vs. GMP positive pressure: the fundamental conflict in facility design!

blocks.zh: 標準 GMP 無菌製程：正壓（Positive Pressure）——防止外部環境污染進入潔淨區
blocks.en: Standard GMP aseptic processing: positive pressure, to prevent contamination from the external environment entering the clean area

blocks.zh: BSL-1/2/3 生物安全要求：負壓（Negative Pressure）——防止危險生物因子（活病毒、細菌）逸出到外部環境
blocks.en: BSL-1/2/3 biosafety requirements: negative pressure, to prevent hazardous biological agents (live viruses, bacteria) escaping into the external environment

blocks.zh: 疫苗生產廠房必須同時滿足兩者，這需要精心的分區設計（Zoning）：在同一廠房中，BSL 區域維持負壓圍堵，病毒滅活後的 GLSP 區域可以恢復正壓 GMP 要求。
blocks.en: A vaccine facility must satisfy both, which requires careful zoning: within the same facility, BSL areas maintain negative-pressure containment, while GLSP areas after virus inactivation can return to positive-pressure GMP conditions.

blocks.zh: 疫苗廠房就像設有負壓隔離室的醫院——普通病房是正壓（防止外部細菌進入保護免疫系統弱的病人），而傳染病隔離室是負壓（防止高度傳染性病原體散播到走廊）。醫院同時擁有正壓區和負壓區，靠精確的壓力分區管理實現。疫苗廠房也一樣：活病毒區域是「隔離室（BSL 負壓）」，病毒滅活後的下游區域恢復「普通潔淨室（GLSP 正壓）」。
blocks.en: A vaccine facility is like a hospital with negative-pressure isolation rooms: ordinary wards are at positive pressure (to keep outside bacteria from reaching immunocompromised patients), while infectious disease isolation rooms are at negative pressure (to keep highly infectious pathogens from spreading into the corridor). A hospital has both positive- and negative-pressure areas, achieved through precise pressure zoning. A vaccine facility is the same: the live virus area is the "isolation room (BSL negative pressure)", and the downstream area after virus inactivation returns to an "ordinary cleanroom (GLSP positive pressure)".

blocks.zh: 「熱區（Hot BSL Zone）」分區的設計智慧：在病毒活性細胞加工室中，如果房間非常大且包含許多製程步驟，可以進一步細分成更小的「清潔區域（Clean-Up Zones）」。這不是為了 GMP 分類，而是為了萬一發生大規模溢漏（catastrophic spill），能夠快速隔離並清潔較小的區域，減少停工時間。
blocks.en: The design logic of "Hot BSL Zone" subdivision: in a virus-infected cell processing room, if the room is very large and contains many process steps, it can be subdivided further into smaller "Clean-Up Zones". This is not for GMP classification, but so that in the event of a catastrophic spill, the smaller area can be isolated and cleaned quickly, reducing downtime.

blocks.zh: 病毒滅活（Inactivation）是關鍵轉折點：一旦病毒被化學或物理方法滅活，該物料就從 BSL（負壓）區域轉移到 GLSP（正壓可接受）區域。這個轉折點的設計——通道、驗證、測試方法——是疫苗廠房設計的核心挑戰之一。
blocks.en: Virus inactivation is the key turning point: once the virus has been inactivated by chemical or physical means, the material moves from the BSL (negative pressure) area to the GLSP (positive pressure acceptable) area. The design of this turning point (routes, validation, test methods) is one of the core challenges of vaccine facility design.

blocks.zh: COVID-19 疫情期間，許多生物製藥廠臨時轉型生產疫苗。主要的廠房改造挑戰包括：將原本設計為正壓的 GMP 潔淨室改造為 BSL-2 負壓設計，需要完整的 HVAC 重新設計（包括排氣過濾系統、壓力控制邏輯）。同時，廠房人員也需要接受生物安全培訓，部分廠房還需要安裝生物安全廢棄物處理系統。這些改造往往是疫苗生產最主要的廠房投資之一。
blocks.en: During the COVID-19 pandemic, many biopharmaceutical facilities were temporarily converted to vaccine production. The main facility modification challenges included converting GMP cleanrooms originally designed for positive pressure into a BSL-2 negative-pressure design, which required a complete HVAC redesign (including exhaust filtration and pressure control logic). Staff also needed biosafety training, and some facilities had to install biohazardous waste handling systems. These modifications are often among the largest facility investments in vaccine production.

blocks.zh: 一個生產流感疫苗的 BSL-2 廠房，其 HVAC 設計與標準 mAb 生產廠房的主要差異是什麼？需要哪些特殊的排氣系統設計？
blocks.en: For a BSL-2 facility producing influenza vaccine, what are the main differences between its HVAC design and that of a standard mAb manufacturing facility? What special exhaust system designs are needed?

blocks.zh: 在疫苗製程中，病毒滅活步驟前後的廠房壓力設計應如何配置？如何透過廠房佈局確保滅活前後的物料不會交叉？
blocks.en: In a vaccine process, how should facility pressures be configured before and after the virus inactivation step? How can the facility layout ensure that material before and after inactivation does not cross?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 ISPE 建議在大型活病毒加工室中進一步細分「清潔區域（Clean-Up Zones）」？這個設計決策的商業驅動力是什麼？
blocks.en: Why does ISPE recommend further subdividing large live-virus processing rooms into "Clean-Up Zones"? What is the business driver behind this design decision?

blocks.zh: 生物安全等級（Biosafety Level, BSL）分類：
blocks.en: Biosafety Level (BSL) classification:

blocks.zh: GLSP（Good Large-Scale Practice）：用於不致病的重組微生物，相當於「BSL-0」，可使用正壓。大多數標準生物製藥（mAb, 重組蛋白）屬於此類。
blocks.en: GLSP (Good Large-Scale Practice): for non-pathogenic recombinant microorganisms, equivalent to "BSL-0", and positive pressure can be used. Most standard biopharmaceuticals (mAbs, recombinant proteins) fall in this category.

blocks.zh: BSL-1：不致病微生物（如非致病性大腸桿菌），需要負壓。
blocks.en: BSL-1: non-pathogenic microorganisms (such as non-pathogenic E. coli); negative pressure is required.

blocks.zh: BSL-2：可引起中度人類疾病的微生物，如流感病毒、腺病毒。需要負壓 + 生物安全柜（BSC）。
blocks.en: BSL-2: microorganisms that can cause moderate human disease, such as influenza virus and adenovirus. Negative pressure + biological safety cabinet (BSC) required.

blocks.zh: BSL-3：可引起嚴重人類疾病的微生物，如結核桿菌、某些狂犬病毒株。嚴格負壓 + 雙重氣鎖 + 特殊防護設備。
blocks.en: BSL-3: microorganisms that can cause serious human disease, such as Mycobacterium tuberculosis and certain rabies virus strains. Strict negative pressure + double airlocks + special protective equipment.

blocks.zh: 6.9 Production Support Areas 生產支援區域
blocks.en: 6.9 Production Support Areas (Production Support Areas)

blocks.zh: 生產支援區域（Production Support Areas）的廠房設計考量：
blocks.en: Facility design considerations for Production Support Areas:

blocks.zh: 支援區域往往在廠房設計初期被低估，但它們直接影響生產效率。各支援功能的位置應根據其與生產的互動頻率來決定：
blocks.en: Support areas are often underestimated early in facility design, but they directly affect production efficiency. The location of each support function should be decided by how often it interacts with production:

blocks.zh: 倉庫（Warehousing）：應靠近生產區域的物料入口，並有清晰的「已放行 vs. 未放行」物料分區。生產從倉庫「拉取（pull）」已放行物料的精實製造概念，要求倉庫動線與生產走廊直接連通。
blocks.en: Warehousing: should be close to the material entrance of the production area, with clearly separated "released vs. unreleased" material zones. The lean manufacturing concept of production "pulling" released material from the warehouse requires warehouse routes to connect directly with the production corridor.

blocks.zh: 製程中 QC（In-Process QC）：生產樣品需要每小時送達 QC 室。QC 室應位於生產區附近（但不必在潔淨區內），以最小化樣品傳遞時間。
blocks.en: In-process QC: production samples must reach the QC room every hour. The QC room should be located near the production area (but need not be inside the cleanroom) to minimize sample transfer time.

blocks.zh: 設施工程（Facility Engineering）：設備維護路線需要通過生產走廊。設施工程工作間（shop）的位置應方便維修工程師快速進入生產區，而不需要每次都穿越整個廠房。
blocks.en: Facility engineering: equipment maintenance routes need to pass through the production corridor. The facility engineering shop should be located so that maintenance engineers can reach the production area quickly, without crossing the whole facility every time.

blocks.zh: 公用設施（Utilities）：WFI、純蒸汽、壓縮空氣的分配點應儘量靠近使用點，以減少管線長度（降低死體積、清洗需求和污染風險）。
blocks.en: Utilities: distribution points for WFI, pure steam and compressed air should be as close to the point of use as possible, to reduce pipe length (lowering dead legs, cleaning needs and contamination risk).

blocks.zh: 生產支援區域就像醫院的後勤系統——藥局（倉庫）、中央化驗室（QC）、醫療設備維修部門（設施工程）、氣體供應室（公用設施）必須都有高效的連接路徑到各個病房（生產室）。醫院如果把藥局建在大樓最遠的角落，護士每次取藥都要走 10 分鐘，整體效率就大幅下降。生物製藥廠也是同樣的道理。
blocks.en: Production support areas are like the back-of-house systems of a hospital: the pharmacy (warehouse), central laboratory (QC), medical equipment maintenance department (facility engineering) and gas supply room (utilities) must all have efficient connecting routes to each ward (production room). If a hospital puts its pharmacy in the farthest corner of the building, nurses have to walk 10 minutes every time they collect medication, and overall efficiency drops sharply. The same logic applies in a biopharmaceutical facility.

blocks.zh: 精實製造（Lean Manufacturing）就是醫院的「即時備藥（Just-In-Time）」系統——藥品在需要的時候剛好到達，不需要大量庫存在護理站。
blocks.en: Lean manufacturing is the hospital's "Just-In-Time" medication preparation system: drugs arrive exactly when needed, with no large stock held at the nurses' station.

blocks.zh: 模組化設計（Modular Design）對新興市場的價值：模組化廠房設計是近年來生物製藥廠建造的重要趨勢。主要優勢包括：
blocks.en: The value of modular design for emerging markets: modular facility design is an important recent trend in biopharmaceutical facility construction. The main advantages include:

blocks.zh: 可在工廠（factory）預建、預測試，減少現場施工時間（縮短 30-50%）
blocks.en: Can be pre-built and pre-tested in a factory, reducing on-site construction time (by 30-50%)

blocks.zh: 設計已被驗證（proven design），新廠不需要從頭設計——直接採用已通過 FDA 查廠的模板
blocks.en: The design is proven: a new facility does not need to be designed from scratch and can directly adopt a template that has already passed FDA inspection

blocks.zh: 複雜潔淨設施的建造技術可以從已有經驗的國家（美、歐）輸出到新興市場（印度、東南亞、非洲）
blocks.en: Construction know-how for complex cleanroom facilities can be exported from experienced countries (US, Europe) to emerging markets (India, Southeast Asia, Africa)

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，模組化設計可以快速複製到不同地點，實現全球產能擴張
blocks.en: For a CDMO, modular design can be replicated quickly at different locations, enabling global capacity expansion

blocks.zh: 精實製造整合思考 Lean Manufacturing Integration
blocks.en: Lean Manufacturing Integration

blocks.zh:
精實製造對廠房設計的指導原則：

1. 價值流（Value Stream）分析：
   原料入庫 → 放行 → 生產 → 製程 QC →
   成品 → 放行 → 出貨

   每個步驟的等待時間 = 廠房設計的優化機會

2. 支援區域的距離最小化：
   QC 樣品路線: 生產室 → QC 實驗室 <5分鐘
   物料補給路線: 倉庫 → 生產室 <同一建築物

3. 消除浪費（Muda）：
   - 不必要的搬運 (Transport)
   - 等待物料放行 (Waiting)
   - 過度加工 (Over-processing)
blocks.en:
Lean manufacturing guiding principles for facility design:

1. Value stream analysis:
   Raw material receipt → release → production → in-process QC →
   finished product → release → shipment

   Waiting time at each step = an optimization opportunity for facility design

2. Minimize distances to support areas:
   QC sample route: production room → QC laboratory <5 minutes
   Material replenishment route: warehouse → production room <same building

3. Eliminate waste (Muda):
   - Unnecessary movement (Transport)
   - Waiting for material release (Waiting)
   - Over-processing (Over-processing)

blocks.zh: 現代生物製藥 CDMO 廠房的設計越來越採用精實製造原則。例如，將品質管制實驗室（QC lab）設計為「快速分析中心」，位於生產廠房旁邊，可在 2-4 小時內完成製程中測試並放行中間產品，而傳統設計中 QC 實驗室設置在獨立建築，樣品傳遞和等待結果可能需要 8-12 小時。這種精實設計直接縮短了批次整體週期時間（Cycle Time），提高生產效率。
blocks.en: Modern biopharmaceutical CDMO facilities increasingly apply lean manufacturing principles. For example, a quality control (QC) laboratory designed as a "rapid analysis center" next to the production facility can complete in-process testing and release intermediates within 2-4 hours, whereas in a traditional design with the QC laboratory in a separate building, sample transfer and waiting for results can take 8-12 hours. This lean design directly shortens the overall batch cycle time and improves production efficiency.

blocks.zh: 在廠房設計階段，如何決定 QC 實驗室的最佳位置？應考慮哪些因素？
blocks.en: At the facility design stage, how do you decide the best location for the QC laboratory? What factors should be considered?

blocks.zh: 一個在印度建設中的新興生物製藥廠考慮採用模組化設計。請列舉模組化設計的三個主要優點和一個潛在挑戰（相較於傳統現場施工）。
blocks.en: A new biopharmaceutical facility under construction in India is considering a modular design. List three main advantages of modular design and one potential challenge (compared with traditional on-site construction).

blocks.zh: 如果倉庫的「物料放行時間」是一個持續的生產瓶頸，精實製造原則建議用哪些廠房設計策略來改善？
blocks.en: If material release time in the warehouse is a persistent production bottleneck, which facility design strategies do lean manufacturing principles suggest to improve it?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary — Chapter 6B (Sections 6.4–6.9)
blocks.en: Section Summary - Chapter 6B (Sections 6.4-6.9)

blocks.zh: 6.4 物流隔離（Logistical Segregation）：核心目的是防止混淆（mix-ups）。有四種主要隔離類型：批次、產品、病毒削減操作、含細胞 vs. 無細胞操作。封閉製程（CIP/SIP、一次性系統）可以安全整合傳統需要隔離的操作，但共用元件（CIP 管線）是最大風險點。
blocks.en: 6.4 Logistical Segregation: the core purpose is to prevent mix-ups. There are four main segregation types: batch, product, virus-reduced operations, and cell-containing vs. cell-free operations. Closed processing (CIP/SIP, single-use systems) can safely integrate operations that traditionally needed segregation, but shared components (CIP lines) are the biggest risk point.

blocks.zh: 6.5 廠房與製程流向：三層目的（邏輯展示、避免混淆、環境保護）。雙走廊（clean supply + dirty return）適合開放製程；封閉製程可採用單走廊——節省廠房面積並簡化驗證。封閉製程消除了 Level 3 流向需求。
blocks.en: 6.5 Facility and Process Flows: three purposes (logical presentation, avoiding mix-ups, environmental protection). A dual corridor (clean supply + dirty return) suits open processing; closed processing can use a single corridor, saving floor area and simplifying validation. Closed processing eliminates the need for Level 3 flows.

blocks.zh: 6.6 清潔與表面完工：設備清洗室採用穿透式設備實現髒-乾淨單向流（二房 vs. 三房設計取決於通量）。CNC/Grade 8/Grade 7 各有對應的表面完工標準和清潔要求，與產品保護關係直接相關。封閉製程中的溢漏通常只是家務問題；開放製程中的溢漏是嚴重的 cGMP 事件。
blocks.en: 6.6 Cleaning and Surface Finishes: equipment wash areas use pass-through equipment to achieve one-way dirty-to-clean flow (two-room vs. three-room design depends on throughput). CNC/Grade 8/Grade 7 each have corresponding surface finish standards and cleaning requirements, directly related to product protection. A spill in closed processing is usually only a housekeeping matter; a spill in open processing is a serious cGMP event.

blocks.zh: 6.7 臨床試驗 vs. 商業生產：Phase I 豁免許多 cGMP 要求；Phase II 及以上必須完全符合 cGMP。Phase II 與商業生產的 cGMP 要求相同，差異只在規模，不在法規。
blocks.en: 6.7 Clinical Trial vs. Commercial Production: Phase I is exempt from many cGMP requirements; Phase II and above must fully comply with cGMP. The cGMP requirements for Phase II and commercial production are the same; the difference is only in scale, not regulation.

blocks.zh: 6.8 疫苗與 BSL 圍堵：最關鍵的設計衝突——BSL（負壓）vs. GMP（正壓）。疫苗廠必須透過精確的壓力分區解決此矛盾。活病毒區域維持負壓（BSL），病毒滅活後恢復正壓（GLSP）。這是疫苗廠設計與標準生物製藥廠最根本的差異。
blocks.en: 6.8 Vaccines and BSL Containment: the most critical design conflict is BSL (negative pressure) vs. GMP (positive pressure). A vaccine facility must resolve it through precise pressure zoning. Live virus areas are kept at negative pressure (BSL), and positive pressure is restored (GLSP) after virus inactivation. This is the most fundamental difference between vaccine facility design and a standard biopharmaceutical facility.

blocks.zh: 6.9 生產支援區域：支援功能（倉庫、QC、設施工程、公用設施）的位置應最小化與生產的互動距離。精實製造原則（拉取系統、消除浪費）指導廠房設計。模組化設計對新興市場尤其有價值——可快速轉移已驗證設計、縮短建廠時間。
blocks.en: 6.9 Production Support Areas: support functions (warehouse, QC, facility engineering, utilities) should be located to minimize the distance of their interaction with production. Lean manufacturing principles (pull systems, waste elimination) guide facility design. Modular design is especially valuable for emerging markets: a proven design can be transferred quickly and facility construction time shortened.
